newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Accumulate Bank of Asia - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Accumulate Bank of Asia - Merrill.

text.p: Merrill Lynch recommended on Wednesday that investors accumulate shares of Bank of Asia, which it said was well managed and had good loan quality.
"We reiterate our 'Accumulate' intermediate term opinion for a bank which we believe is professionally managed and whose loan quality appears under control," Merrill Lynch said in a report.
"Under professional management, we believe that BOA is making good progress in all aspects of its operations," it said.
Merrill estimated the small-sized bank's non-performing loans at around 8.2 percent of its total loans at the end of first half compared with seven percent at the end of 1996.
Merrill Lynch expects Bank of Asia's net profit in 1997 to be 1.85 billion baht ($61.7 million) compared with 1.8 billion a year earlier.
Bank of Asia this week reported an unaudited profit of 846.5 million in the first half compared with 807 million baht in the year-earlier period.
